title: Headset slips
intro: You'll move the headset on your face on purpose, with one hand, a few millimetres at a time, and hold it there while you look at dots. A beep says when to move it, a low beep when to let go. Then you take it off and on.

steps.text: Look at the dot. When it says Push up and beeps, push the headset up a few millimetres with one hand. Hold it there until it says Let go and beeps low.
Keep holding the headset there. Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
Keep holding it until it says Let go. Then put the headset back as it was, and look at the dot.
Look at the dot. When it says Pull down and beeps, pull the headset down a few millimetres with one hand. Hold it there until it says Let go and beeps low.
Keep holding the headset there. Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
Keep holding it until it says Let go. Then put the headset back as it was, and look at the dot.
Look at the dot. When it says Slide to your left and beeps, slide the headset a few millimetres to your left with one hand. Hold it there until it says Let go and beeps low.
Keep holding the headset there. Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
Keep holding it until it says Let go. Then put the headset back as it was, and look at the dot.
Look at the dot. When it says Slide to your right and beeps, slide the headset a few millimetres to your right with one hand. Hold it there until it says Let go and beeps low.
Keep holding the headset there. Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
Keep holding it until it says Let go. Then put the headset back as it was, and look at the dot.
Look at the dot. When it says Tilt: left side up and beeps, tilt the headset so its left side goes up a little with one hand. Hold it there until it says Let go and beeps low.
Keep holding the headset there. Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
Keep holding it until it says Let go. Then put the headset back as it was, and look at the dot.
Take the headset off, put it back on as you usually do, then press the button.
Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
